kitnc:
Product information

Designed for everyday comfort and printed on soft, high-quality combed cotton.

Features

  • 100% organic cotton
  • Ecological dyeing
  • Modern cut
  • Lightweight fabric (145 g/m²)
  • Professionally printed on demand by TPOP in Europe
  • Durable, high-quality print
  • There is no collar tag for comfort, just a size chip.

Sizing guide

Kids 2-14 years

  • 2–4 years: 33.5 cm wide × 39 cm long
  • 4–6 years: 35 cm wide × 44 cm long
  • 6–8 years: 36.5 cm wide × 49 cm long
  • 8–10 years: 39 cm wide × 54 cm long
  • 10–12 years: 42.5 cm wide × 59 cm long
  • 12–14 years: 46 cm wide × 64 cm long

Measurements may vary slightly.

Care instructions

  • Wash at 30°C
  • Wash inside out
  • Wash with similar colours
  • Do not bleach
  • Iron inside out
  • Do not iron directly on the printed artwork
  • Air drying is recommended

Print on demand & shipping

At Kinditude, we currently produce every T-shirt only after it has been ordered. We use TPOP, one of the most sustainability-focused print-on-demand companies we could find in Europe. Their production methods and commitment to responsible manufacturing align closely with our own values.

Production typically takes 3–7 business days, after which your order is shipped. Delivery times vary depending on your destination.

Returns

As every Kinditude T-shirt is currently printed on demand especially for you, we are currently unable to accept returns or exchanges due to selecting the wrong size, changing your mind, or personal preference. Please refer to the sizing guide before placing your order.

Damaged or defective items
If your T-shirt arrives damaged, has a manufacturing defect, or you receive the wrong item, please contact us within 14 days of delivery with your order number, a brief description of the issue, and clear photographs of the product and packaging. We will review your claim together with our production partner and arrange a replacement or refund where appropriate.

Prices are for all 26 letters. Prints ship unframed.

Collector benefits

Complete collection – every letter reserved for you from the moment of purchase.

Collector reduction – 20% less than purchasing all 26 artworks individually.

Exhibition invitations – selected exhibitions, private previews and special events.

Meet the artist – exclusive online sessions presenting newly released letters and the stories behind them.

Early access – priority access to future releases, books and exhibitions.

Collection continuity – remaining artworks are delivered automatically as they become available.

Recognition – a numbered Complete Alphabet Collector Certificate and a signed letter of appreciation.

Paper & print quality

Every artwork is produced as a museum-quality giclée print on Hahnemühle FineArt Studio Enhanced. Renowned for its archival properties and exceptional color fidelity, it delivers outstanding detail, depth and a smooth matte finish designed to last for generations.

Delivery

Released letters ship upon purchase. During our pre-launch phase, production and delivery may take 1–3 weeks.

Upcoming letters are reserved in your name and delivered as each one is produced. You'll be notified by email with every release.

Need it by a date? Contact us before ordering and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Returns & refunds

If you're not fully satisfied, you may return an artwork within 14 days of receiving it, in its original undamaged condition and packaging, including all protective materials.

Return shipping – limited edition fine art requires specialized handling, so return shipping, packaging, tracking and insurance are the customer's responsibility until the artwork is received and inspected.

Damaged artwork – please inspect your package on delivery. If the packaging is damaged, photograph it before opening and report it to the carrier. Contact us right away with photos of the artwork and packaging and we'll resolve it as quickly as possible.
